overview: Supporting Kroger Technology's quality engineering (QA) initiatives as part of ZopSmart's engineering team. Contributing to multiple customer-facing iOS and Android applications serving millions of shoppers across the United States — ensuring high-quality, reliable, and accessible experiences at enterprise scale.

projects.name: Search Platform
projects.overview: Automated the end-to-end search experience for Kroger's iOS and Android applications — one of the highest-traffic features used by millions of shoppers daily to discover and purchase products.
scope: Predictive Search & typeahead suggestions automation
Search Results page — product grid, relevancy, pagination
Visual Navigation & category browse flows
Sort & Filter panel — all filter combinations and state persistence
Search Analytics event verification and tracking validation
A/B testing experiment validation and feature flag support
Zero-results and error-state handling coverage
Cross-platform parity testing (iOS vs Android)
projects.impact: Automated regression coverage for Kroger's most critical discovery feature, enabling confident weekly releases with zero manual regression.

projects.name: Account & Auth
projects.overview: Validated secure, seamless customer authentication and account management flows across iOS and Android — critical paths that gate every personalised Kroger shopping experience.
scope: Login & Registration flow automation (email, social, SSO)
Multi-factor authentication (MFA) validation
Password reset and account recovery journeys
User profile management and preference updates
Session management and token refresh testing
API and UI integration testing for backend-driven experiences
Cross-platform authentication parity validation
Security-sensitive flow regression coverage
projects.impact: Ensured zero-regression on authentication flows across all major Kroger app releases, protecting millions of customer accounts.

projects.name: Shopping List
projects.overview: Automated the Shopping List platform — Kroger's personalised shopping companion used by millions of customers to plan, manage, and fulfil their weekly grocery runs across all channels.
scope: Shopping List creation, naming, and management workflows
Add, edit, remove, and reorder items automation
Item quantity, unit, and note field validation
List synchronisation across devices and platforms
AI-powered item recommendations and suggestions
Cross-device user experience consistency validation
Backend API integration and data persistence testing
Customer engagement feature regression coverage
projects.impact: Delivered full automation coverage for Kroger's most-used engagement feature, reducing manual QA effort and improving release cadence.
